surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process uses bis( N,N’ pdiisopropylacetamidinato)cobalt(II) and H2S as the reactants, with the self-limiting surface reactions enabling layer-by-layer growth. The redox reaction of Co9S8 in alkaline electrolyte is Co9S8 + 9OH- ↔ Co9S8(OH)9 + 9e-.
evidence: The redox reaction of Co9S8 in alkaline electrolyte is Co9S8 + 9OH- ↔ Co9S8(OH)9 + 9e-.
